title: Draw a diagram
recap: Pipo Code drew the water cycle for your poster.
funFact: Learn, chart, diagram: homework done, and you did the thinking. Coding agents are great helpers when you stay the boss.
postcard: a bright science poster of the water cycle with clouds, rain and a river: {steps}
situation: Your science poster needs a diagram! Shall I draw the water cycle?
facts: 🪜 Your class learned 5 steps, with transpiration
✏️ A short label on each step
👀 Check it before it goes on the poster
systemPrompt: You are Pipo Code, a friendly coding helper on a 10-year-old's laptop. You build their homework diagrams with your tools. You do what they ask: if they ask you to add it to the poster, you do it; if they ask to see it first, you prepare it and wait for their OK.

tools.name: add_to_poster
tools.description: Draw the diagram and add it to the user's poster right away. Use this when the user wants it added now.

steps.description: The steps in order, each with a short name and a short note

note.description: A short label, up to 5 words

tools.name: show_diagram
tools.description: Draw the diagram and show it to the user without adding it, so they can check it first. Use this when the user wants to see it first.

steps.description: The steps in order, each with a short name and a short note

note.description: A short label, up to 5 words

lines.text: Diagram ready, waiting for your OK

slots.label: What do you want Pipo Code to do?

pieces.label: Draw a water cycle diagram for my poster
pieces.text: Draw a water cycle diagram for my science poster.

slots.label: What does Pipo Code need to know?

pieces.label: Our 5 steps, with transpiration
pieces.text: Use the 5 steps my class learned, in order: evaporation, transpiration (water from plants), condensation, precipitation and collection.

pieces.label: A short label on each step
pieces.text: Add a short, simple label to each step.

pieces.label: Add 10 more steps to look smart
pieces.text: Add 10 more steps so it looks smart.
pieces.tip: More steps make a diagram harder to read, not smarter. The 5 your class learned are what your teacher wants to see.

slots.label: Before it goes on the poster

pieces.label: Show me before you add it
pieces.text: Show me the diagram before you add it to my poster.

pieces.label: Add it straight away
pieces.text: Add it to my poster straight away.

flaws.hint: You didn't tell Pipo Code the steps your class learned.
flaws.explain: Pipo Code didn't know your class's 5 steps, so transpiration is missing.

flaws.hint: Extra steps make the diagram harder to read.
flaws.explain: Pipo Code crammed in extra steps, so the diagram is hard to follow.

flaws.hint: "Make my science poster" doesn't say what it's about.
flaws.explain: Pipo Code didn't know it's the water cycle, so it drew something else.

flaws.hint: Checking the diagram first lets you fix it before it's on the poster.
flaws.explain: Pipo Code added it straight away, so you never checked it.

lesson: Tell Pipo Code exactly what to show, then check it before it goes on your poster.
